title: Analysis: fit-feature sidecars per sample (per-beat tonalness, log bands, onsets, bass share) plus CLAP embeddings per clip and region
description: Spec section 2b (see the epic's comment) plus CLAP now (user decision). A sidecar npz per sample keyed by manifest sha: per-beat tonalness, 24 log bands on a quarter-beat grid, onsets, bass share; CLAP (LAION, the smallest music-capable checkpoint) audio embeddings per saved clip and per bar-grid region window. Script scripts/fit-features.py; incremental, skips up-to-date samples. Acceptance: all 148 manifests in <= 10 min (CLAP extra budget stated), sidecars <= 10 MB excluding CLAP; CLAP stored separately; a text-prompt probe ('smooth deep house pad', 'brass band') ranks known clips sensibly; tests on a synthetic sample. Disk is tight (~13 GB free): state the model download size before fetching and keep caches out of git.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in PR #17 (squash into develop). Sidecars next to manifests (git-ignored): fitfeat 4.8 MB for 124 samples (24 without a beat grid, mostly one-shots), CLAP (laion/clap-htsat-unfused; larger_clap_music's text tower is degenerate with transformers 5.17) 9.7 MB. Chunked subprocesses plus forward batches of 8 keep peak RSS ~2 GB. tests/test_features.py 13/13.
